definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an omega-methyl-medium-chain fatty acid + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = an omega-hydroxy-medium-chain fatty acid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]. A medium-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 6 to 12 carbons.
label: medium-chain fatty acid omega-hydroxylase activity
